title: When Rewards Depend on the Group, GRPO Plays a Tournament
abstract: arXiv:2611.02404v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rewards for diversity, coverage and distribution matching make the reward of each sampled response depend on the rest of its group, and they are now routinely optimized with GRPO and RLOO. We prove that in this setting the group-relative baseline changes the objective. The expected update equals each response's own reward gradient plus $\alpha$ times its effect on its groupmates' rewards, with $\alpha=-1/(K-1)$ for groups of size $K$, so GRPO trains every response to beat its groupmates in a zero-sum tournament. It cannot see a pairwise diversity bonus when K=2, sees less than half of it at any K, and often does worse than using no baseline at all. Setting $\alpha=+1$ gives Team-GRPO, an unbiased estimator for any group-dependent reward that works with two samples per prompt and requires no extra model calls for pairwise rewards. translated_title: 当奖励依赖于组群时，GRPO 就在进行一场锦标赛
translated_abstract: 针对多样性、覆盖度和分布匹配的奖励使得每个采样响应的奖励取决于其组内的其他响应，而这类奖励如今通常使用GRPO和RLOO来优化。我们证明在这一设定下，组相对基线会改变优化目标。期望更新等于每个响应自身奖励的梯度，再加上α乘以其对组内同伴奖励的影响，其中对于大小为K的组，α=-1/(K-1)，因此GRPO实际上是在训练每个响应在一场零和锦标赛中击败其组内同伴。当K=2时，它完全无法感知成对多样性奖励；在任何K值下，它感知到的都不足一半，而且其效果常常比完全不使用基线还要差。将α设为+1即得到Team-GRPO，这是一种对任何依赖于组群的奖励都无偏的估计器，只需每个提示采样两次即可工作，且在处理成对奖励时无需额外的模型调用。该理论能够定量预测训练过程，例如将一个9B策略的不动点定位到0.02的精度范围内。
tldr: 该论文证明GRPO的组相对基线会把组依赖奖励（如多样性奖励）的优化目标扭曲为零和锦标赛，导致模型感知不到甚至负向对待组内同伴的奖励，并提出α=+1的Team-GRPO无偏估计器，只需每个提示两次采样即可正确优化任何组依赖奖励。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that GRPO's group-relative baseline distorts the optimization of group-dependent rewards into a zero-sum tournament, and introduces Team-GRPO (with α=+1), an unbiased estimator that correctly optimizes any group-dependent reward using only two samples per prompt.
